text: I am on a bridge or probably just stepped out of a Taxi. That is the Mekong River with kids swimming in it. The taxi driver's name was VC Charlie or that's what we called him. He knew me and Ronnie Tototz. 90% of the time Ronnie and I rode with VC Charlie. He was a nice guy making a living and always laughing.
